Add-on · custom scope

Business Systems & Automation

For businesses that want to organize customer inquiries and reduce repetitive work.

Connect your website to customer management and automated follow-up.

Available features, depending on scope:

  • Customer CRM and email signup
  • Automated welcome and inquiry confirmation emails
  • Private event or service inquiry tracking
  • Staff notifications and follow-up reminders
  • A simple management dashboard

Can be added to either website package. Existing websites can be reviewed for compatibility.
